name: zha-device-handlers-universal-tuya-weekly-ee27
instr:
zha-device-handlers cannot inspect and edit weekly programs consistently across incompatible Tuya thermostat representations. Implement canonical, immutable, capability-aware schedules without changing thermostat control or discovery behavior.

Canonicalize schedules by weekday group and increasing start time, including empty schedules. Before writes, reject invalid clocks, temperatures, duplicate starts, overlapping groups, and invalid edits.

Every Tuya thermostat exposes `schedule_capability()`, `schedule_snapshot()`, and `begin_schedule_edit(schedule)`. Snapshots mark incomplete reports without inventing periods. Unsupported inspection or editing raises `ScheduleUnsupportedError` without mutation.

Decode both Moes six-period groups into centidegrees. Preserve the other group and reported hour flags. Write only the appropriate packed group. Canonicalize out-of-order reports and advance the revision once per distinct accepted payload.

Assemble Haozee fragments in any order. Preserve them across device replacement, replace stale contributions, and complete from remaining fragments after replacement or invalid edits without a duplicate revision. Write only changed fragments through the original source cluster.
